milestones.title: M0 — Engineering Foundation
milestones.description: Reproducible web/API/PostgreSQL/PostGIS/CI repository before production features.

milestones.title: M1 — World Explorer
milestones.description: Interactive globe → country selection → real canonical profile from Go and PostgreSQL. Authentication follows in M3.

issues.title: Establish repository structure and engineering conventions
issues.body:
## Outcome

Make the baseline understandable before implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] README, AGENTS, CONTRIBUTING and SECURITY describe current status and permanent rules.
- [ ] Product/architecture docs cover scope, data classes, non-goals and milestones.
- [ ] Document target directories without speculative empty scaffolding.
- [ ] Document scoped branches/PRs, Conventional Commits and definition of done.
- [ ] Local links resolve; proposed capabilities are not described as implemented.

## Dependencies

None.

## References

- `docs/product/specification-v0.1.md`
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- `AGENTS.md`

**Phase:** M0. **Baseline:** World Observatory v0.1. Proposed labels: type:docs.

issues.title: Bootstrap Next.js web application
issues.body:
## Outcome

Establish a reproducible TypeScript frontend.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Create apps/web with verified compatible Next.js/React/TypeScript versions and one committed lockfile.
- [ ] Add only used baseline dependencies; no authentication/globe/future feature scaffolding.
- [ ] Document exact install/dev/lint/typecheck/build commands and runtime version.
- [ ] Provide an accessible baseline page and suitable security headers.
- [ ] Clean install and configured lint/typecheck/build pass.

## Dependencies

M0-01

## References

- `docs/architecture/frontend.md`
- `docs/architecture/deployment.md`

**Phase:** M0. **Baseline:** World Observatory v0.1. Proposed labels: type:chore, area:web.

issues.title: Bootstrap Go HTTP API with health endpoint
issues.body:
## Outcome

Run Go/Chi with a documented health response.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Create api/cmd/server with Chi/slog; verify and pin Go 1.27+ target or explicitly document its resolution.
- [ ] Implement GET /api/v1/healthz with defined response; explain liveness versus database readiness.
- [ ] Add finite HTTP timeouts, graceful shutdown and request IDs without secret logging.
- [ ] Validate configuration and document startup commands.
- [ ] An httptest check verifies the response; format/vet/tests/build pass.

## Dependencies

M0-01

## References

- `docs/architecture/backend.md`
- `docs/architecture/api.md`

**Phase:** M0. **Baseline:** World Observatory v0.1. Proposed labels: type:chore, area:api.

issues.title: Establish golang-migrate and sqlc workflow
issues.body:
## Outcome

Make schema changes and generated database access repeatable.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Configure db/migrations and db/queries with verified pinned golang-migrate/sqlc tooling.
- [ ] Provide minimal initial migration and required extension setup.
- [ ] Document clean up/down, generation commands and generated-file policy.
- [ ] Verify fresh migration and regeneration without generated drift.
- [ ] Do not add visits/trips/provider schemas before their slices.

## Dependencies

M0-03, M0-04

issues.title: Define initial OpenAPI contract
issues.body:

Establish the canonical health contract and deterministic frontend types.

issues.title: Establish canonical country seed/import strategy
issues.body:
## Outcome

Choose a sourced, reproducible catalogue strategy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Review official sources; record dated licence, attribution, coverage and redistribution requirements.
- [ ] Define stable identities/ISO mapping and a separately sourced 195-country challenge collection.
- [ ] Document territory/disputed-boundary exceptions and map-feature join strategy.
- [ ] Define canonical fields, refresh cadence and idempotent/transactional import policy.
- [ ] Record fixture/download provenance and M1 validation checks without inventing facts.

## Dependencies

M0-01

## References

- `docs/data-sources/README.md`
- `docs/product/geographic-model.md`

**Phase:** M0. **Baseline:** World Observatory v0.1. Proposed labels: type:docs, area:data.

issues.title: Add CI baseline for frontend and backend
issues.body:
## Outcome

Run actionable reproducibility and security checks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Use minimal workflow permissions and verified pinned tooling/runtime versions.
- [ ] Run Go format/vet/static checks/tests/build and race detector where practical.
- [ ] Run configured frontend lint/typecheck/tests/build.
- [ ] Validate OpenAPI/generated drift and migration/sqlc consistency as applicable.
- [ ] Add actionable govulncheck, frontend dependency audit and secret scanning.
- [ ] Document local equivalents; tests never rely on live providers.

## Dependencies

M0-02, M0-03, M0-05, M0-06

issues.title: Add initial architecture documentation and ADRs
issues.body:
## Outcome

Record why significant architectural choices belong here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Create ADR-001 through ADR-009 with context, decisions, alternatives and consequences.
- [ ] Cover monolith, Go, Next.js, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, MapLibre, adapters, provenance/freshness, limited infrastructure and versioned editorial data.
- [ ] Document backend/frontend/database/geography/providers/caching/provenance/deployment boundaries.
- [ ] Distinguish accepted direction from completed implementation.
- [ ] Document supersession and check cross-document consistency.

## Dependencies

M0-01

- `docs/adr/README.md`

issues.title: Import canonical country catalogue into PostgreSQL
issues.body:
## Outcome

Store real profiles locally with reproducible imports.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add country migration/schema/constraints from the reviewed M0 strategy.
- [ ] Implement idempotent sync/seed with source, retrieval/version and attribution.
- [ ] Keep catalogue/territories distinct from 195-country collection membership.
- [ ] Persist real panel fields including Portugal/Lisbon/EUR/Portuguese/Europe.
- [ ] Fixture and database checks cover repeated imports and invalid data.
- [ ] Document exact import/verification commands.

## Dependencies

M0-05, M0-07, M0-08

## References

issues.title: Expose canonical country list and profile endpoints
issues.body:
## Outcome

Read country profiles from PostgreSQL through the world module.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Implement GET /api/v1/countries and /api/v1/countries/{iso2} with defined fields, excluding large polygons.
- [ ] Define identifier normalization and malformed/unknown-code error responses.
- [ ] Update OpenAPI and regenerate frontend types.
- [ ] Use parameterized SQL/sqlc and request contexts.
- [ ] HTTP/real-database checks prove PT lookup and invalid/unknown handling.
- [ ] No external provider is required in the request path.

## Dependencies

M1-01, M0-06

## References

- `docs/architecture/api.md`
- `docs/architecture/backend.md`

issues.title: Build interactive MapLibre globe with country selection
issues.body:
## Outcome

Make Earth functional navigation with stable selection.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Use verified globe-capable MapLibre and reviewed optimized map data with attribution.
- [ ] Deliver map datasets/tiles separately from profile API payloads.
- [ ] Resolve supported polygons including PT to stable identifiers; handle mapping exceptions.
- [ ] Provide accessible keyboard/search/list selection and responsive layout.
- [ ] URL parameters preserve Explore layer/country, direct links and browser navigation.
- [ ] Handle map loading/failure visibly; do not add unimplemented thematic layers.

## Dependencies

M0-02, M0-07, M1-02

## References

- `docs/architecture/frontend.md`
- `docs/architecture/geography.md`

**Phase:** M1. **Baseline:** World Observatory v0.1. Proposed labels: type:feature, area:web, area:data.

issues.title: Connect country selection to a real country information panel
issues.body:
## Outcome

Display API-backed information for the selected country.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Use generated contract types and appropriate server-state handling for the internal API.
- [ ] Selecting PT shows Portugal, Lisbon, EUR, Portuguese and Europe from API data.
- [ ] Cover loading, empty/unknown, error/retry states and suitable focus behaviour.
- [ ] Closing/changing selection updates URL and works on mobile.
- [ ] Component checks cover success/errors without hardcoded profiles or frontend provider calls.

## Dependencies

M1-02, M1-03

## References

- `docs/architecture/frontend.md`
- `docs/product/country-intelligence.md`

**Phase:** M1. **Baseline:** World Observatory v0.1. Proposed labels: type:feature, area:web.

issues.title: Verify the globe-to-country vertical slice end to end
issues.body:
## Outcome

Prove actual web → Go → PostgreSQL selection reproducibly.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Run against migrated/seeded PostgreSQL and actual Go API rather than replacement country data.
- [ ] Playwright proves selection and the visible Portugal panel.
- [ ] Verify direct URLs/navigation, accessible selection and meaningful API failure state.
- [ ] Document clean startup/test commands and run the workflow in CI.
- [ ] Use deterministic test data/map fixtures; do not depend on live intelligence providers.
- [ ] Record responsive/accessibility and deployment-path limitations before declaring M1 complete.

## Dependencies

M1-04, M0-08

## References

- `docs/architecture/testing.md`
- `docs/architecture/deployment.md`
